description: This file defines a factory class 'ParamsMiddlewareFactory' that creates middleware instances for handling parameters in an API context, specifically within the Slim framework. It injects dependencies via the constructor and provides a 'bind' method to generate middleware functions that utilize container services.

classes.name: ParamsMiddlewareFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating middleware functions that handle parameters, utilizing dependency injection through a container.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with a container for dependency injection.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Creates and returns a middleware function that constructs and invokes ParamsMiddleware with dependencies fetched from the container.
